$comment: Bhavya Diagram Design profile. Canonical constraints for any diagram produced with the third-party diagram-design skill. Authority: AGENTS.md + docs/architecture/PLATFORM-TRUTH.md. Enforced by scripts/diagrams/test-profile.mjs and scripts/diagrams/validate-diagrams.mjs.

typography.$comment: Taken from packages/platform-ui/src/styles/tokens.css. Never hardcode a font that is not in the token file.
forbidden: @import url(...) pointing at an external host
typography.$rationale: The upstream skill references fonts.googleapis.com in 224 files. Left intact, an exported diagram makes an external request at render time, discloses a visitor IP to a third party, and renders outside the canonical Bhavya type system. Strip before export; the SVG validator is a backstop, not a substitute.

colour.rule: Use token values only. No hardcoded brand colours.

accessibility.transcript_required_when: the diagram encodes meaning that cannot be conveyed by a short alt text

responsive.rule: Export with an explicit viewBox and width/height so the SVG scales without rasterisation.

mobile.requirement: scales via viewBox; no fixed pixel width above 100%

desktop.requirement: scales via viewBox; legible at 100% zoom

prohibited: paid services or any service requiring a payment method
diagrams presented as fact without human factual review
